The '''''Rindoon Dart''''' was a [[Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser]] owned by the [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pwi'lin]]. Its design featured at least one [[Wing (technology)|wing]], and it was equipped with twin [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] interior featured seats for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the copilot, and its cargo hold contained a bench running along its walls. Pwi'lin also had the ship fitted with a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] as well as supposedly changed the position of the craft's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], thereby enhancing its performance.<ref name="Tethan" /> The ship shared its name with the [[Rindoon system/Legends|Rindoon system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the ''Rindoon Dart'' was landed at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] near a [[Unidentified Raidos cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raidos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Pwi'lin then visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] while his [[Pwi'lin's first mate|first mate]] remained on the ship.<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We've had some problems getting parts for the ''Rindoon Dart''&mdash;that's my ship, she's a Sandonian 4XA Prensile cruiser&mdash;from the merchants here on Teth, who only seem to have old stock for the clunkers they ordinarily service.|Pwi'lin in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Dyd2_bg.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The ''Rindoon Dart'' appeared in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''.]]
The ''Rindoon Dart'' appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In an adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], meets the character Pwi'lin in the Raidos cantina.<ref name="Tethan" />

During their conversation, Pwi'lin&mdash;who, unbeknownst to the youngling, intends to capture and [[Slavery/Legends|sell]] them to a [[Unidentified mine owner|mine owner]] in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] settlement<ref name="Tethan" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], in the Outer Rim's [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;is contacted via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] by his first mate, leading to the enslaver briefly replying in his [[Pwi'lin's language|own language]]. Pwi'lin then claims that, although the pair had difficulties obtaining parts for the ''Rindoon Dart'' from the local [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], the first mate has successfully repaired the craft. At that point, the enslaver, even though he and his first mate are supposedly in a hurry to depart, invites the young Tethan to see his vessel.<ref name="Tethan" />

At the spaceport, while the ''Rindoon Dart''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engines]] are roaring in preparation for departure, the youngling admires the ship and Pwi'lin gives them a quick tour around the craft's exterior, pointing out some of its modifications while his first mate gestures for him to hurry up. Abruptly, Pwi'lin grabs the youngling and drags them up the ''Rindoon Dart''{{'s}} entry ramp. Yelling for the first mate to take them out of the spaceport, the enslaver then uses a pair of [[Binders/Legends|security bracelets]] to fasten the Tethan's [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and legs to the bench in the ship's cargo hold. The ''Rindoon Dart'' subsequently transports the bound and gagged captive to Cloud City, where they are transferred to the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] owner's transport.<ref name="Tethan" />
